description: 在 VS Code 中管理和编译 Keil uVision 工程

title: Compny
description: AI code completion powered by OpenAI.

title: Entire for VS Code
description: Browse the Entire checkpoints behind your commits, the agent sessions behind each checkpoint, and the trails of repositories on entire.com.

title: LookFirst: See What Code Does Before You Run It
description: Shows what code would build or do before you run it: a picture of servers, ports, files and websites it touches, and the risks in plain English. Reads the code without running it. Nothing leaves your computer unless you ask the AI to explain a problem, and then you see exactly what is sent.

title: Project Color Picker
description: Change the look of the current project (status bar, title bar, etc.) with a color picker.

title: TODO 看板
description: 收集项目中的 TODO / FIXME / NOTE 注释，在侧边面板中展示、筛选、跳转与标记完成

title: DataStep Studio for R (Clinical)
description: See what your R program did, stop where it goes wrong, prove your fix. RStudio layout, a log that explains every step, a debugger, pipeline and data viewer, tidyverse formatting with proof, and an optional AI agent you can check. Made for clinical trials.

title: Sound Shapes GameMonkey
description: GameMonkey script support for the Sound Shapes engine: completion, hover docs, signature help and highlighting for every engine native.

title: SoundShaper Mods
description: Make SoundShaper mods for Sound Shapes: .edit files checked against the game's files, mod.json checks, dependencies, previews, downloading mods from a Sound Shapes server, and installing mods as a patch archive for any version of the game.

title: Deepseek AI Assistant
description: Copilot-style inline completions and an agentic chat panel powered by DeepSeek.

title: Markdown to Copyable PDF
description: Turns Markdown into an A4 PDF with Edge or Chrome, where every code line can be copied in full. Long commands are split automatically, code that cannot be split is printed smaller, with page numbers and offline Mermaid diagrams.

title: Anlogic Tiller
description: 为 Copilot Agent 提供安路 TD 技能，并注册 anxinwen 与本机 TD MCP 两个 MCP 服务。

title: Testing QCS Playwright Automation Agent
description: Generate Playwright tests from Azure DevOps test cases via the ADO and Playwright MCP servers. Deterministic scaffolding, mismatch detection, prerequisite + ADO-origin checks; agent prompt loaded privately from Azure DevOps.

title: Img Preview
description: Blazing fast, lightweight image preview in editor gutter and hover tooltip. Supports SVG, WebP, PNG, JPEG, GIF, AVIF, ICO, Data URIs & remote URLs.

title: Monkeytype for VS Code
description: Quick access to Monkeytype inside Visual Studio Code's integrated browser.

title: SSH Config Manager
description: Manage your ssh_config from a GUI: groups, icons, colors, tags and notes — all stored as comments inside the config file itself.

title: Workspace Folder Toggle
description: Checkbox view to include or exclude folders in your multi-root workspace and save straight to the .code-workspace file.
